correctness.rationale: For SPD S=[[K,t sqrt(K)],[t sqrt(K),1]] and Z=diag(K,1), the exact frozen L_Z^{-1}(A-X^2) updates give X1=S+diag(t^2/2,Kt^2/2) and X2 diagonals K-t^4/(8K),1-K^2t^4/8 and offdiagonal t sqrt(K)(1-t^2/2). The second diagonal is negative for K>2 sqrt(2)/t^2 while first stays positive; X2 indefinite. Direct differentiation yields eigenvalues ±t,0,0 and Frobenius operator norm t sqrt((K+K^-1)/2); X1 error ratio t sqrt(K+K^-1)/(2sqrt(2)). Hence relative initial error tends zero but absolute error amplification unbounded. Checked exact rational K=16,t=1/2 witness and noncommuting conditions.
